description: Production vllm7 (amd/Qwen3.8-27B-Quark-AWQ-MXFP4 + DFlash2 k=7, LXC 2408). The gate reuses the live docker-vllm7.service arguments, so this profile only declares what to assert.
required_log_patterns: all linear layers on our kernel
\[radiance\.mxfp4\] linear layers: (\d+)/\1 on our kernel, 0 FORCED
forbidden_log_patterns: Capturing CUDA graphs? failed|CUDAGraph capture failed
known_warnings: Cubin file saved by TritonBundler not found
Failed to JIT torch c dlpack extension

smoke.name: arithmetic
smoke.prompt: What is 17*23? Reply with the number only.

smoke.name: reasoning parser
smoke.prompt: A train leaves at 14:35 and arrives 2h47m later. What time does it arrive? Answer with HH:MM only.

smoke.name: tool call
smoke.prompt: What is the weather in Berlin? Use the tool.

smoke_note: Every answer is additionally checked for leaked <think>/</think> tags (reasoning parser armed); an empty reasoning_content is normal for easy prompts.
